title: Ben's Very Big Pocket
synopsis: Ben stuffs a coat pocket with ordinary treasures and opens a very silly temporary museum on Far Meadow's Sitting Stone.
continuity_state: Before: Wendy now knows the three visitors; the Sitting Stone is on Amy's map. After: Sitting Stone hosts the first imaginary Pocket Museum; Amy adds a tiny spoon symbol beside it; Ben takes all his items home in a bag.
